definition: DESI RVSpecFit template-fit bracket alpha-to-iron abundance [alpha/Fe]
coordinate: native linear bracket-abundance coordinate; do not exponentiate or take a logarithm
unit_evidence: Official DR1 data model identifies ALPHAFE as [alpha/Fe] from template fitting. Immutable paper v4 Appendix C quantifies RVS alpha offsets and residual scatter in dex. Blank FITS TUNIT is recorded, not falsely claimed to contain dex.
quality_policy: Original SUCCESS and PRIMARY true; RVS_WARN zero; RR_SPECTYPE STAR; SN_R >=10; finite positive native error; positive int64 Gaia SOURCE_ID; native sky association <=1arcsec.
known_limitations: DR1 paper Appendix B warns alpha abundances at FeH below about minus2 are overestimated and not recommended.
Appendix C reports RVS alpha offset about0.12dex and scatter about0.1dex against APOGEE; no invented correction or uncertainty floor is applied.
Single native source-scale predictive pilot, not cross-survey alpha calibration or physical-truth claim.
metal_poor_cal_test_status: diagnostic measured-label comparisons only; source alpha labels are not recommended physical abundances in this regime
